artifacts.summary: The trans-arrival substrate refactor: succession separated from state-identity, the empty-certificate-class record retired, and a six-condition certificate landed for each temporal direction at non-trivial sharing.

completion_data.completion_summary: All twelve phases of the trans-arrival substrate refactor are implemented and green. SharingSkeleton now carries a fourth periodic datum for succession plus the lift obligation it creates, Thread.step reads the arrival-pruned trans relation, and (C1')'s two temporal clauses quantify over succession rather than over share-classes. The five declarations recording an empty L-plus certificate class for a stability modal over a tense operator were retired together with their C2 baseline and theorem-index rows, and four positive results replaced them: plusCertifies_stabSnce_example and plusCertifies_stabUntl_example are six-condition certificates at non-trivial sharing, and not_snce_share_congr and not_untl_shift_share_congr refute the retired congruences rather than merely leaving them unproved. Soundness did not move: plusTruth_iff_mem, plusRefutes_of_certifies and total_eq_thread are byte-identical to their pre-refactor form.

partial_progress.details: All 12 phases COMPLETED. Phases 1-5 in dispatch 6; phases 6-12 in dispatch 7.
